en: Why this matters
zh: 为什么这件事重要

en: A validated claim means the corpus supports the statement under the core's rules — it does not mean the passage says everything the sentence suggests. Read the quoted span in its context before you rely on it. "What the AI said" and "what Lacan's text proves" are two different things, and only the second one belongs in your argument.
zh: 一条 validated claim 的意思是：在内核的规则下，语料**支持**这条陈述 —— 它**不**意味着那段原文说了这句话暗示的全部内容。在你依赖它之前，先把它引用的那句放回上下文里读。「AI 说了什么」和「拉康原文证明了什么」是两件事，能进你论证的只有后者。

en: When the trace is incomplete
zh: 当溯源不完整

en: Some witnesses are available for corpus research while their upstream publication or edition trace is incomplete. Those passages are marked SOURCE_TRACE_INCOMPLETE. This is a scholarly limitation of the source, not an operational error and not a UI bug: the text is still usable, it just cannot carry a full bibliographic citation.
zh: 有些见证本可以用于语料研究，但它们的上游出版/版本溯源不完整。这些段落会被标 SOURCE_TRACE_INCOMPLETE。这是来源的**学术限制**，不是运行错误，也不是界面 bug：文本仍可用，只是扛不起一条完整的书目引用。

zh: 你拿到了带引用的答案、至少打开过一个 passage 的原文、并且把它存进了 Project 或 Obsidian。少任何一步，它都还只是草稿，不是一条研究材料。

en: If you see PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE after pressing {{ui:research.submit}}: you selected {{ui:provider.llm}} without credentials. Offline research still works completely; nothing is broken and nothing needs fixing.
zh: 如果按下 {{ui:research.submit}} 后看到 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE：说明你选了 {{ui:provider.llm}} 但没有凭据。离线研究仍然完全可用，没有坏任何东西，也不需要修。

en: Next: how evidence and provenance work
zh: 下一步：证据与溯源是怎么组织的

en: Lacan Knowledge OS is a local-corpus research environment. It sends a question to a frozen scholarly core, which retrieves evidence only from the local corpus (the Staferla French seminar transcripts and the Chinese translation project) and then produces an answer that carries citations. When the corpus cannot support the question, the core abstains instead of answering from model knowledge. Offline / Mock mode needs no credentials at all.
zh: Lacan Knowledge OS 是一个本地语料驱动的研究环境。它把问题交给冻结的学术内核，内核只在本地语料（Staferla 法文研讨班文本与中文翻译项目）里检索证据，然后产出带引用的答案。语料撑不住这个问题时，内核**弃权**，而不是用模型知识补一个答案。离线 / 模拟（Offline / Mock）模式完全不需要任何凭据。

en: Three ways in, and they answer different needs: {{ui:nav.research}} starts from a question, {{ui:nav.explore}} starts from the material, {{ui:nav.projects}} turns repeated research into a long-term topic.
zh: 三个入口，对应的需要不同：{{ui:nav.research}} 从**问题**出发，{{ui:nav.explore}} 从**材料**出发，{{ui:nav.projects}} 把一次次研究变成**长期课题**。

en: For your first run, leave Provider on Offline / Mock. It is deterministic, takes seconds, and spends nothing.
zh: 第一次试，Provider 保持「离线 / 模拟」。它是确定性的、几秒出结果、不花任何额度。

en: Short, verifiable pages for the things you actually do here: ask a question, check the evidence, browse the corpus, keep a project, manage sources, and continue in Obsidian. Every control name in this Help is rendered from the real product interface, so it cannot drift from what you see on screen.
zh: 这里只写你真正会做的事：提问、查证据、读语料、做长期项目、管理来源、在 Obsidian 继续。本 Help 里出现的每个控件名都是从真实产品界面取的，不可能和屏幕上的对不上。

zh: 它们不是一回事

zh: 改变产品界面：导航、按钮、标签、状态、空状态、错误提示，以及本 Help。它**从不**改动语料文本。

zh: {{ui:topbar.language}}（界面语言）

zh: 作为 question language 随研究请求发送。它**不**翻译界面，也**不**过滤或限制检索。

zh: {{ui:topbar.researchLanguage}}（研究语言）

zh: 一个合法的组合

zh: 界面 = 中文，研究语言 = Français。你用中文读产品，同时告诉内核你的问题是用法文写的。两个设置都记在你的浏览器里，彼此独立。

zh: 界面语言永远不碰的东西

zh: 拉康原文与被引用的段落文本

zh: 机器 token，例如 passage id、复核状态与状态码

en: Switching the interface language does not reload the page and does not touch any scholarly content: compare a passage id and its text before and after and they are identical.
zh: 切换界面语言不会刷新页面，也不会改动任何学术内容：切换前后对比同一个 passage 的 id 与文本，逐字节相同。

zh: 两个彼此独立的设置。界面中文 + 研究语言法文完全合法。

zh: 界面语言 vs 研究语言

zh: 证据、检索、来源、校验、书目与引用完整性。

en: Lacan Knowledge OS
zh: Lacan Knowledge OS

en: Your understanding, long-term notes, writing and your concept network.
zh: 你的理解、长期笔记、写作，以及你自己的概念网络。

en: Obsidian
zh: Obsidian

en: Obsidian is not the underlying database. Corpus, ontology and validation live in this system; Obsidian holds notes, and a note never becomes canonical evidence by being written there.
zh: Obsidian **不是**底层数据库。语料、本体与校验都在本系统；Obsidian 保存的是笔记，而一条笔记不会因为写在那里就变成 canonical 证据。

en: How to open it
zh: 怎么打开

en: Use {{ui:home.open-obsidian}} on the home page, or {{ui:nav.obsidian}} in the navigation.
zh: 用首页的 {{ui:home.open-obsidian}}，或导航里的 {{ui:nav.obsidian}}。

en: Both use the configured vault. The default vault root is _workspace/obsidian_vault inside this project.
zh: 两者都用已配置的 vault。默认 vault 根目录是本项目内的 _workspace/obsidian_vault。

en: If no obsidian:// URI is configured, the page tells you the folder to open directly instead of failing silently.
zh: 如果没有配置 obsidian:// URI，页面会告诉你要直接打开哪个文件夹，而不是静默失败。

en: What gets saved
zh: 会保存什么

en: From an answer: {{ui:research.save-to-obsidian}} writes the run as a document.
zh: 从答案：{{ui:research.save-to-obsidian}} 把这次运行写成一个文档。

en: From the inspector: {{ui:evidence-inspector.save-passage}} writes a single passage with its provenance.
zh: 从检查器：{{ui:evidence-inspector.save-passage}} 把单个段落连同溯源写下来。

en: Saved research is not evidence by itself — every conclusion still has to be supported by the corpus, and the saved note keeps the ids so you can re-check.
zh: 保存下来的研究本身**不是**证据 —— 每个结论仍然必须由语料支持；笔记里保留了 id，方便你回查。

en: Your own notes inside the vault are never overwritten by these products.
zh: vault 里你自己的笔记，永远不会被这些产物覆盖。

en: Evidence and provenance
zh: 证据与溯源

en: Where your own understanding lives. Not the database.
zh: 你自己的理解待的地方。它不是数据库。

en: Obsidian
zh: Obsidian

en: Person ≠ Case
zh: Person ≠ Case

en: A person who appears in the corpus as a reference point: Freud, Hegel, Descartes, Saussure, Kojève, Lévi-Strauss, Schreber.
zh: 在语料中作为参照点出现的人物：Freud、Hegel、Descartes、Saussure、Kojève、Lévi-Strauss、Schreber。

en: Person
zh: 人物

en: A clinical case as a case: Aimée, Dora, Little Hans, Schreber, the Wolf Man.
zh: 作为个案存在的临床个案：Aimée、Dora、Little Hans、Schreber、狼人。

en: Case
zh: 个案

en: person.schreber ≠ case.schreber. They are distinct entities: the case links to its subject person, it does not collapse into it. Searching one will not silently return the other.
zh: person.schreber ≠ case.schreber。它们是两个不同实体：个案会链到它所对应的人物，但不会并入人物。查其中一个，不会悄悄返回另一个。

en: How the registries are built
zh: 登记表是怎么建的

en: Matching is deterministic alias matching over real corpus text — there is no automatic named-entity recognition promoting anything into canonical data.
zh: 匹配是对真实语料文本做**确定性别名匹配** —— 没有自动 NER 把任何东西提升为 canonical 数据。

en: An entry appears with its attestation count; a term needs enough real mentions before it is listed.
zh: 每个条目带语料证据计数；一个词要有足够真实提及才会被列出。

en: The registry is read-only browsing: nothing you do in the UI promotes an entity.
zh: 登记表是只读浏览：界面上的操作不会提升任何实体。

en: Candidates that are not yet canonical stay candidates.
zh: 还没成为 canonical 的候选，就仍然是候选。

en: Why there is no influence inference
zh: 为什么没有「影响推断」

en: The system does not infer that one person influenced another, or that a case "is" a concept. Those are scholarly judgements, and the corpus records mentions — not causality. Use Explore to see the mentions, then make the argument yourself, with citations.
zh: 系统**不**推断谁影响了谁，也不推断某个个案「就是」某个概念。那些是学术判断，而语料记录的是**提及**，不是因果。用 Explore 看提及，然后由你自己、带着引文去论证。

zh: 打开人物

zh: 打开个案

zh: 两张不同的登记表，绝不能被合并成一张。

en: What a Project is
zh: Project 是什么

en: Only stable ids are stored. The passage or concept text is always re-read from the canonical store, so a project never keeps its own copy of the corpus.
zh: 只存稳定 id。段落与概念的文本每次都从 canonical 存储重读，所以项目永远不保存语料自己的副本。

en: A Project is a USER_WORKSPACE object: it organises references, questions and runs. It is never evidence, and it can never promote a note into a canonical claim. Research can stay project-less — nothing is forced into a project.
zh: Project 是一个 USER_WORKSPACE 对象：它组织引用、问题与运行记录。它**永远不是证据**，也不可能把一条笔记提升为 canonical claim。研究完全可以不挂项目 —— 没有东西会被强制塞进项目。

en: What belongs in a Project
zh: 什么该放进 Project

en: Research questions, with the runs that answered them
zh: 研究问题，以及回答过它们的那几次运行

en: Hypotheses you are testing (they are never mixed into validated claims)
zh: 你在验证的假设（它们**不会**混进 validated claims）

en: Passages you picked while reading
zh: 阅读时挑出来的段落

en: Persons and cases you keep coming back to
zh: 你反复回到的人物与个案

en: Bibliography items you are working from
zh: 你在用的书目条目

en: Open questions, notes and status
zh: 悬而未决的问题、笔记与状态

en: Documents saved from runs into Obsidian
zh: 从运行保存进 Obsidian 的文档

en: Create one
zh: 建一个

en: Open {{ui:nav.projects}}.
zh: 打开 {{ui:nav.projects}}。

en: In {{ui:projects.new-project}}, fill {{ui:projects.project-title}} (required), optionally {{ui:projects.project-description-optional}} and {{ui:projects.project-tags-comma-separated}}.
zh: 在 {{ui:projects.new-project}} 里填 {{ui:projects.project-title}}（必填），可选填 {{ui:projects.project-description-optional}} 与 {{ui:projects.project-tags-comma-separated}}。

en: Press {{ui:projects.create-project}}. The new project opens immediately.
zh: 按 {{ui:projects.create-project}}。新项目会立刻打开。

en: Open Projects
zh: 打开 Projects

en: Put research into a Project
zh: 把研究放进 Project

en: On any answer, use {{ui:explore.add-to-project}} on the action bar. Each run is stored as an immutable snapshot of the answer exactly as the core returned it — re-researching the same question creates a new item, it does not overwrite the old one.
zh: 在任何答案上，用动作条里的 {{ui:explore.add-to-project}}。每次运行都按内核返回的原样、作为不可变快照保存 —— 同一个问题重新研究会**新增**一条，不会覆盖旧的。

en: A workspace object that holds a topic over time. Not evidence.
zh: 一个跨时间保存课题的工作区对象。它不是证据。

en: Projects
zh: Projects（长期课题）

en: Three different starting points
zh: 三个不同的起点

en: You do not know yet what the corpus says. You get an evidence-backed answer with citations, and a state that tells you how well supported it is.
zh: 你还不知道语料里有什么。你得到一个有证据支撑、带引用的答案，以及一个说明它被支持到什么程度的状态。

en: Research — starts from a question
zh: Research —— 从「问题」出发

en: You know what you want to read or look up. You get passages, sessions, concepts, terms, persons, cases — and no conclusion.
zh: 你已经知道要读什么、查什么。你得到段落、session、概念、术语、人物、个案 —— 以及**没有**结论。

en: Explore — starts from the material
zh: Explore —— 从「材料」出发

en: You get a workspace object that holds questions, hypotheses, runs, passages, persons, cases and bibliography over months. Project content is not corpus evidence.
zh: 你得到一个工作区对象，用来跨月保存问题、假设、运行、段落、人物、个案与书目。**Project 里的内容不是 corpus evidence。**

en: Projects — turns runs into a topic
zh: Projects —— 把一次次的运行变成课题

en: Three real examples
zh: 三个真实例子

en: "How does Seminar XI distinguish the eye from the gaze?" — a question about the corpus → Research.
zh: 「Seminar XI 里 eye 和 gaze 怎么区分？」—— 关于语料的问题 → Research。

en: "Show me Seminar XI, session 5, in the French original." — you already know the material → Explore.
zh: 「把 Seminar XI 第 5 次课的法文原文给我看。」—— 你已经知道材料在哪 → Explore。

en: "I will work on objet petit a for three months." — a long-term topic → a Project, which then collects the Research runs and the passages you picked.
zh: 「objet petit a 我要做三个月。」—— 长期课题 → 建一个 Project，再把 Research 运行与挑出来的段落收进去。

en: The rule of thumb
zh: 一句话判断

en: If you would phrase it as a question, use Research. If you would phrase it as "show me", use Explore. If you would phrase it as "I will keep working on this", use a Project.
zh: 你能把它说成**一个问题**，用 Research。你能把它说成「**给我看**」，用 Explore。你能把它说成「**我会一直做下去**」，用 Project。

en: An AI answer is not the end of research. The evidence and the original text are the verification entry point: open the citation before you believe the claim.
zh: AI 回答不是研究的终点。**证据与原文才是验证入口**：在看到 claim 之后就打开它的引文。

zh: 怎么验证：证据链

zh: 打开 Explore，自己读材料

zh: 这个系统里最值得先弄清的一组区分。

zh: Research 用来做什么

en: Abstention is a result, not an error
zh: 弃权是结果，不是错误

en: ABSTAINED means the corpus cannot support a reliable answer. That is the correct behaviour, and the answer card explains why in its abstention block. An abstention never contains invented claims, so do not go looking for one.
zh: ABSTAINED 表示语料撑不起一个可靠答案。这是**正确行为**，答案卡会在 abstention 块里说明原因。弃权里不会有编造的 claim，所以不要去找。

en: Where the evidence is
zh: 证据在哪

en: Every claim carries citation chips. Click one and the Evidence Inspector opens with the passage, its context window and its source chain. The answer shows what the core concluded; the inspector shows what the corpus actually says.
zh: 每条 claim 都带引文 chip。点开一个，Evidence Inspector 会给出该段落、它的上下文窗口与来源链。答案是内核的结论，Inspector 才是语料真正说的话。

en: How evidence works
zh: 证据是怎么组织的

en: When the provider is unavailable
zh: 当 provider 不可用

en: Provider is its own layer of system status. If it is DEGRADED or unavailable, {{ui:provider.mock}} research continues to work. The system never falls back to model knowledge to fill the gap.
zh: Provider 是**独立的一层**系统状态。它 DEGRADED 或不可用时，{{ui:provider.mock}} 研究照常可用。系统**不会**用模型知识去补这个缺口。

en: Open troubleshooting
zh: 打开故障排查

en: Research starts from a question. The core retrieves passages from the local corpus, builds an evidence contract, and only then synthesises an answer whose claims must survive citation and entailment validation. Nothing is answered from the model's own knowledge.
zh: Research 从**问题**出发。内核先在本地语料里检索段落、构建证据契约，然后才生成答案；答案里的每条 claim 都必须通过引用与蕴含校验。**没有**任何内容来自模型自己的知识。

en: How to ask
zh: 怎么问

en: One question per run. Two questions in one box produce one muddled answer.
zh: 一次只问一个问题。一个框里塞两个问题，只会得到一个含混的答案。

en: Ask about what the corpus contains: a concept, a distinction, a seminar, a passage, a case, a term.
zh: 问语料里**真的有**的东西：一个概念、一组区分、某次研讨班、某段文本、某个个案、某个术语。

en: Questions about external facts (dates, attendees, publication history) will abstain — the corpus does not carry that metadata.
zh: 问外部事实（日期、在场者、出版史）会弃权 —— 语料不携带那类元数据。

en: Questions are limited to 2000 characters and are never silently truncated: an over-long question is rejected instead.
zh: 问题上限 2000 字符，且**不会**被静默截断：过长的问题会被直接拒绝。

en: Ask again later rather than editing a submitted question: each run is stored as its own item.
zh: 想改问题就重新问一次；每次运行本身都会作为独立条目保存下来。

en: The controls
zh: 控件

en: How the question is read: {{ui:mode.scholarly}} is the default research mode; the Advanced group narrows the task (concept, relation, comparison, diachronic, seminar-specific, translation, formalism, case).
zh: 问题按哪种方式理解：{{ui:mode.scholarly}} 是默认研究模式；Advanced 组收窄任务类型（概念、关系、比较、历时、特定研讨班、翻译、形式化、个案）。

zh: {{ui:topbar.mode}}

zh: {{ui:provider.mock}} 不调用任何模型；{{ui:provider.llm}} 会把合成步骤发给真实端点，必须由你显式选择。

zh: {{ui:topbar.provider}}

zh: 随请求发送的 question language。它不翻译界面，也不过滤检索。

zh: {{ui:topbar.researchLanguage}}

en: Skip the product cache and recompute this question. Without it, an identical repeat may be served from cache — the answer header says which happened.
zh: 跳过产品缓存、真重算一次。不勾时，完全相同的问题可能直接命中缓存 —— 答案头部会写清是哪一种。

zh: {{ui:research.fresh}}

zh: 答案状态

en: Every answer carries a state. Read it literally: VALIDATED, VALIDATED_WITH_QUALIFICATIONS, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, VALIDATION_FAILED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, ABSTAINED (plus STRUCTURALLY_UNAVAILABLE and UNKNOWN). The full glossary, including what to do about each, is on the Status reference page.
zh: 每个答案都带一个状态，请按字面读：VALIDATED、VALIDATED_WITH_QUALIFICATIONS、PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED、VALIDATION_FAILED、INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE、ABSTAINED（另有 STRUCTURALLY_UNAVAILABLE 与 UNKNOWN）。每个状态「为什么出现、你该做什么」的完整词典在「状态速查」页。

en: Why: credentials missing or the endpoint refused/failed. The system never substitutes model knowledge to cover this.
zh: 为什么：凭据缺失，或端点拒绝/失败。系统**不会**拿模型知识来填这个洞。

en: What to do: switch to {{ui:provider.mock}}, or open Model provider settings and press {{ui:provider.test}} to check the endpoint.
zh: 你该做什么：切回 {{ui:provider.mock}}，或打开 Model provider settings，按 {{ui:provider.test}} 检查端点。

en: Error? It is a real error, but a local one — offline research is unaffected.
zh: 算错误吗：是真错误，但只影响这一条路径 —— 离线研究不受影响。

en: Answer states
zh: 答案状态

en: ABSTAINED
zh: ABSTAINED

en: The corpus cannot support a reliable answer, so the core declined to answer. The abstention block says what is missing.
zh: 语料撑不起一个可靠答案，于是内核拒绝作答。abstention 块会说明缺什么。

en: Why: the evidence sufficiency stage judged the contract insufficient.
zh: 为什么：证据充分性阶段判定契约不足。

en: What to do: narrow the question, or go to Explore and read the material yourself.
zh: 你该做什么：把问题收窄，或直接去 Explore 自己读材料。

en: Error? No — abstention is a correct output.
zh: 算错误吗：不算 —— 弃权是正确输出。

en: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
zh: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

en: There is some material, but not enough to support the answer.
zh: 有材料，但不足以支撑这个答案。

en: Why: retrieval returned too little usable evidence for the claim shape you asked for.
zh: 为什么：检索到的可用证据相对于你要的 claim 形态太少。

en: What to do: ask a narrower question, or check the term in Explore to see real attestations.
zh: 你该做什么：问得更窄一些，或在 Explore 里查这个词的真实出现情况。

en: Error? No.
zh: 算错误吗：不算。

en: VALIDATION_FAILED
zh: VALIDATION_FAILED

en: Something was produced but it did not survive citation/entailment validation, so it is not presented as a supported answer.
zh: 有产出，但没通过引用/蕴含校验，因此不作为被支持的答案呈现。

en: READY
zh: READY

en: Why: generated claims failed the validators and were rejected.
zh: 为什么：生成的 claim 没通过校验器，被剔除了。

en: What to do: read the Advanced / Audit panel to see generated/validated/rejected counts, then rephrase the question.
zh: 你该做什么：读 Advanced / Audit 面板看 generated/validated/rejected 计数，然后换个问法。

en: Error? No — the validation worked; the answer just was not supportable.
zh: 算错误吗：不算 —— 校验正常工作了，只是这个答案立不住。

en: Source and citation statuses
zh: 来源与引用状态

en: SOURCE_TRACE_INCOMPLETE
zh: SOURCE_TRACE_INCOMPLETE

en: The text is available for corpus research, but its upstream publication/edition trace is incomplete.
zh: 该文本可用于语料研究，但它的上游出版/版本溯源不完整。

en: Why: the witness is known and usable, but the publication chain is not fully documented.
zh: 为什么：见证本是已知且可用的，但出版链没有被完整记录。

en: What to do: use the text and cite it internally; do not expect a formal bibliographic style for it.
zh: 你该做什么：照常使用并对它做内部引用；不要期待它给出正式书目样式。

en: Error? No — it is a scholarly limitation of the source, not a system bug.
zh: 算错误吗：不算 —— 这是来源自身的学术限制，不是系统 bug。

en: NEEDS REVIEW · NOT CITABLE
zh: NEEDS REVIEW · NOT CITABLE

en: This record is a candidate: no citation of any style can be produced from it.
zh: 该记录是 candidate：无论哪种样式都不能从它生成引用。

en: Why: it was imported or added, and has not been promoted to reviewed metadata.
zh: 为什么：它是导入或新增的，还没有被提升为已复核元数据。

en: What to do: use it as a working reference and keep it in a project; produce citations from reviewed records.
zh: 你该做什么：把它当工作引用用、挂进项目；要出引用就用已复核的记录。

en: Error? No.
zh: 算错误吗：不算。

en: BIBLIOGRAPHIC_METADATA_INCOMPLETE
zh: BIBLIOGRAPHIC_METADATA_INCOMPLETE

en: The record exists and may be reviewed, but it lacks the fields a formal citation style requires.
zh: 记录存在、甚至已复核，但缺少正式引用样式所必需的字段。

en: That layer is working normally.
zh: 该层工作正常。

en: Why: publisher, year, ISBN or page data were never verified for it.
zh: 为什么：它的出版社、年份、ISBN 或页码从未被核验过。

en: What to do: read citation availability per style; the reason is listed. Internal citation still works.
zh: 你该做什么：看逐样式的引用可用性，原因会列出来。内部引用照常可用。

en: Error? No.
zh: 算错误吗：不算。

en: METADATA_CONFLICT / {{ui:bibliography.conflict}}
zh: METADATA_CONFLICT / {{ui:bibliography.conflict}}

en: Two records disagree about the same work (for example different years). Nothing is overwritten.
zh: 两条记录对同一部作品的描述不一致（例如年份不同）。没有任何一边被覆盖。

en: Why: import or manual entry produced conflicting metadata.
zh: 为什么：导入或手工录入产生了互相冲突的元数据。

en: What to do: look at both sides and decide. There is no automatic resolution in this version.
zh: 你该做什么：两边都看，由你判断。当前版本没有自动裁决。

en: Error? No — it is a deliberate stop for human judgement.
zh: 算错误吗：不算 —— 这是刻意停下来交给人判断。

en: UNRESOLVED
zh: UNRESOLVED

en: A question or entry is explicitly left open rather than guessed at.
zh: 某个问题或条目被**明确地**留作未决，而不是被猜一个答案。

en: Why: the system refuses to fill a gap it cannot support.
zh: 为什么：系统拒绝去填一个它撑不住的洞。

en: What to do: keep it in a project as an open question, or find the source that would close it.
zh: 你该做什么：把它当开放问题留在项目里，或去找能真正关掉它的来源。

en: Error? No.
zh: 算错误吗：不算。

en: Troubleshooting
zh: 故障排查

en: Why: the layer answered its health check.
zh: 为什么：该层通过了健康检查。

en: What to do: nothing.
zh: 你该做什么：什么都不用做。

en: Error? No.
zh: 算错误吗：不算。

en: DEGRADED
zh: DEGRADED

en: The layer runs with reduced ability — typically the provider layer with no credentials configured.
zh: 该层以受限能力运行 —— 通常是 provider 层没有配置凭据。

en: Why: an optional capability is missing, not a failure.
zh: 为什么：缺的是一个可选能力，不是故障。

en: What to do: keep working offline; configure credentials only if you want real-LLM synthesis.
zh: 你该做什么：继续离线工作；只有想用真实大模型合成时才需要配置凭据。

en: Error? No — it is a configuration state.
zh: 算错误吗：不算 —— 这是配置状态。

en: PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
zh: PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE

en: You asked for {{ui:provider.llm}} but no usable provider/credential was available, so the synthesis step could not run.
zh: 你选了 {{ui:provider.llm}}，但没有可用的 provider/凭据，合成步骤跑不起来。

en: Every status you will meet: what it means, why it appears, what to do, and whether it is an error.
zh: 你会遇到的每个状态：什么意思、为什么出现、你该做什么、算不算错误。

en: Status reference
zh: 状态速查

en: No such Help topic
zh: 没有这个帮助主题

en: That address does not match any Help page. Pick a topic from the list, or start with the quick start.
zh: 该地址不对应任何帮助页。请从左侧目录选一个主题，或从快速开始读起。

en: Topics
zh: 目录

en: Research does not work, but Explore does
zh: Research 用不了，但 Explore 能用

en: Chinese material shows SOURCE_TRACE_INCOMPLETE
zh: 中文材料显示 SOURCE_TRACE_INCOMPLETE

en: That is expected for a translation witness whose upstream publication chain is not fully documented. It is a scholarly limitation of the source — not a UI bug, and not a sign that the text is unusable.
zh: 对一个上游出版链没有被完整记录的翻译见证本来说，这是**预期行为**。它属于来源的学术限制 —— 不是界面 bug，也不代表文本不可用。

en: The passage is still retrievable, quotable internally, and usable as evidence.
zh: 该段落仍然可检索、可内部引用、可作为证据使用。

en: What you lose is the formal bibliographic citation for that witness.
zh: 你失去的只是那个见证本的正式书目引用。

en: The marker stays visible on purpose; hiding it would misrepresent the source.
zh: 这个标记是**故意**保持可见的；把它藏起来等于误述来源。

en: Zotero import shows a conflict
zh: Zotero 导入出现冲突

en: A conflict means the imported record and an existing one disagree on the same work. The system reports it and stops there — it does not pick a winner, and it does not overwrite either side.
zh: 冲突意味着导入的记录与已有记录对同一部作品说法不一致。系统报告它，然后停在那里 —— 它不挑赢家，也不覆盖任何一边。

en: Both records remain visible; read them side by side.
zh: 两条记录都还在，并排读。

en: There is no conflict-resolution editor in this version, and no automatic merge.
zh: 当前版本没有冲突解决编辑器，也没有自动合并。

en: Imported items stay candidates: NEEDS REVIEW · NOT CITABLE until a human promotes them.
zh: 导入的东西保持 candidate：NEEDS REVIEW · NOT CITABLE，直到有人把它提升。

en: If you need a decision recorded, do it deliberately rather than expecting the import to settle it.
zh: 如果你需要留下一个决定，请显式地做，别指望导入替你裁决。

en: The interface language did not switch
zh: 界面语言没有切换

en: Check {{ui:topbar.language}} in the top bar: it has exactly two values, English and 中文, and it switches immediately without reloading the page.
zh: 看顶栏的 {{ui:topbar.language}}：它只有 English 与 中文 两个值，切换**立即**生效，不刷新页面。

en: Interface language and {{ui:topbar.researchLanguage}} are different controls; changing one never changes the other.
zh: 界面语言与 {{ui:topbar.researchLanguage}} 是两个不同控件；改一个永远不会改另一个。

en: The chosen interface language is remembered in this browser, so a deep link can override it for one page (a ?uiLocale= parameter in the address).
zh: 选择的界面语言记在这个浏览器里，所以深链可以覆盖它一页（地址里的 ?uiLocale= 参数）。

en: If the interface is still in the old language after a switch, that is a defect worth recording — not something to work around.
zh: 如果切换后界面还是旧语言，那是一个应当被登记的缺陷 —— 不是需要你绕开的东西。

en: Status reference
zh: 状态速查

en: Interface vs research language
zh: 界面语言 vs 研究语言

en: That combination is the provider layer, not the system. Explore reads the corpus directly; Research additionally needs a synthesis step.
zh: 这个组合说明问题在 provider 层，不在系统本身。Explore 直接读语料；Research 额外需要一步合成。

en: If Provider shows DEGRADED and you selected {{ui:provider.llm}}: switch to {{ui:provider.mock}}, or configure credentials and press {{ui:provider.test}}.
zh: 如果 Provider 显示 DEGRADED 而你选了 {{ui:provider.llm}}：切回 {{ui:provider.mock}}，或配置凭据后按 {{ui:provider.test}}。

en: If you see PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: the endpoint refused or no credential was found. Offline research is still fully available.
zh: 如果看到 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE：端点拒绝或没找到凭据。离线研究仍然完全可用。

en: If research is disabled for a core-integrity reason, the page says so explicitly — do not try to work around it; run the Check launcher instead.
zh: 如果是核心完整性原因导致研究被禁用，页面会明说 —— 不要绕过它，改用 Check 启动器。

en: A concept cannot be found
zh: 找不到某个概念

en: Explore and Research only see what the local corpus contains. A missing concept is usually a corpus limitation, not a search bug.
zh: Explore 与 Research 只看得到本地语料里有的东西。找不到某个概念，通常是**语料限制**，不是搜索 bug。

en: Try the term in its French form, and try known variants or aliases.
zh: 试试它的法文写法，以及已知的变体或别名。

en: Check the attestation count: a term with zero attestation genuinely does not appear in the indexed text.
zh: 看语料证据计数：计数为 0 的词，确实没有出现在已索引文本里。

en: Terminology matching is deterministic alias matching — it will not guess a related concept for you.
zh: 术语匹配是确定性别名匹配 —— 它不会替你猜一个相关概念。

en: If you believe the term should be there, that is a corpus question: record it rather than forcing a match.
zh: 如果你认为这个词本该在语料里，那是一个**语料问题**：记下来，而不是硬凑一个匹配。

en: Citation unavailable
zh: 引用不可用

en: Formal styles (Chicago / APA / MLA / BibTeX) are offered only when verified publication metadata exists. When it does not, the interface lists the reason instead of producing a plausible-looking citation.
zh: 正式样式（Chicago / APA / MLA / BibTeX）只在存在**已核验出版元数据**时提供。没有的时候，界面会列出原因，而不是生成一条看起来像样的引用。

en: Read the per-style availability row: it names the missing requirement.
zh: 看逐样式可用性那一行：它写明了缺什么。

en: A reviewed record can still be metadata-incomplete — reviewed ≠ complete.
zh: 一条已复核的记录仍然可能元数据不完整 —— reviewed ≠ 完整。

en: Internal citation (passage id, witness, provenance) is available independently of the formal styles.
zh: 内部引用（passage id、见证本、溯源）与正式样式无关，照常可用。

en: Never hand-build a citation from a record marked NOT CITABLE.
zh: **不要**用标着 NOT CITABLE 的记录手工拼一条引用出来。

en: The six things that actually go wrong, and what each one means.
zh: 真正会出问题的六件事，以及它们各自的含义。

en: Troubleshooting
zh: 故障排查

en: What can be imported
zh: 能导入什么

en: Supported: CSL JSON and Better BibTeX JSON. Export one of those from Zotero and import the file here. Nothing else is parsed.
zh: 支持：CSL JSON 与 Better BibTeX JSON。从 Zotero 导出其中之一，再把文件导入这里。其他格式不会被解析。

en: The real flow
zh: 真实流程

en: Open {{ui:nav.bibliography}} and expand {{ui:bibliography.import-zotero-csl-json}}.
zh: 打开 {{ui:nav.bibliography}}，展开 {{ui:bibliography.import-zotero-csl-json}}。

en: Select the file. The system parses it.
zh: 选择文件。系统解析它。

en: Read {{ui:bibliography.preview}}: you see exactly what would be imported, and what would be flagged.
zh: 读 {{ui:bibliography.preview}}：你会看到到底会导入什么、什么会被标出来。

en: Duplicates and conflicts are shown. A {{ui:bibliography.conflict}} is reported, not adjudicated.
zh: 重复项与冲突会被显示。{{ui:bibliography.conflict}} 只**报告**，不裁决。

en: Press {{ui:bibliography.import-as-candidate}}. Everything arrives as a candidate.
zh: 按 {{ui:bibliography.import-as-candidate}}。所有东西都以 candidate 身份进来。

en: Why everything is still a candidate afterwards
zh: 为什么导入之后还是 candidate

en: Imported items are always candidates. There is no "approve all" step and no automatic canonicalization.
zh: 导入的东西**永远是** candidate。没有「全部批准」这一步，也没有自动 canonicalization。

en: Nothing is automatically merged into an existing record.
zh: 不会自动并进已有记录。

en: A conflict never silently overwrites either side: it stays visible so a human can decide.
zh: 冲突**不会**静默覆盖任何一边：它留在那里，等人来判断。

en: The candidate keeps saying NEEDS REVIEW · NOT CITABLE, because that is still true — no citation can be produced from it yet.
zh: candidate 会继续标 NEEDS REVIEW · NOT CITABLE，因为它确实还是这样 —— 目前还不能从它生成引用。

en: There is no conflict-resolution editor in this version. Conflicts are recorded and displayed for you to act on; the product does not pretend to resolve them.
zh: 当前版本**没有**冲突解决编辑器。冲突会被记录并显示，由你来处理；产品不会假装替你裁决。

en: Open the import section
zh: 打开导入区

en: How review status and citation work
zh: 复核状态与引用是怎么回事

en: Two supported file formats, one result: candidates.
zh: 只支持两种文件格式，结果只有一个：candidate。

en: Zotero import
zh: Zotero 导入

en: Saved items live in the product workspace. History is not evidence: every conclusion must still be re-supported by the corpus.
zh: 保存的内容放在产品工作区里。历史不是证据：每个结论仍然必须由语料重新支持。

zh: 开始第一次研究

zh: 还没有保存的研究

en: Open Bibliography
zh: 打开 Bibliography

en: Review sources, metadata completeness and citation availability, and import Zotero data.
zh: 查看书目来源、metadata 完整性、引用能力并导入 Zotero 数据。

en: Manage sources and citations
zh: 管理文献与引用

en: Browse Concepts
zh: 浏览概念

en: See concepts, terms and related passages, and how a term is used across periods.
zh: 查看概念、术语、相关 passage，并观察它在不同阶段的使用。

zh: 研究一个概念

en: Person / Case Explorer
zh: 人物 / 个案浏览

zh: 浏览 Freud、Hegel、Schreber 等人物，以及 Dora、Aimée、狼人等个案。

en: Study persons and cases
zh: 研究人物与个案

en: Open Explore
zh: 打开 Explore

en: Search passages, seminars, sessions and terms, and read the original context.
zh: 直接搜索 passage、Seminar、Session、术语以及原始上下文。

en: Find text and sources
zh: 寻找原文与出处

en: Open Projects
zh: 打开 Projects

en: Keep questions, hypotheses, passages, persons, cases and bibliography together and move a topic forward.
zh: 保存问题、假设、passages、人物、个案和书目，持续推进一个课题。

en: Build a long-term project
zh: 建立长期研究项目

en: Start Research
zh: 开始 Research

en: Let the core retrieve evidence from the existing corpus and produce a sourced research answer.
zh: 让系统根据现有语料检索证据，再生成有出处的研究回答。

zh: 问一个拉康问题

zh: 提出问题

zh: 查看支持证据

zh: 深入原文

zh: 保存研究材料

zh: 整理来源

zh: 形成自己的知识

zh: AI 回答不是研究终点：证据与原文才是验证入口。

zh: 一次完整研究如何进行

zh: 第一次使用？

zh: 开始一次研究

en: One research task, end to end: ask, verify, read the original, save it, sort the sources — and know when the corpus cannot support the question.
zh: 一次研究任务的全程：提问、核对、读原文、存档、整理书目——以及语料撑不住时，系统会明说。

en: Start from a question, retrieve the original text, check the evidence, organise the concepts, build a research project — and carry the work on into Obsidian.
zh: 从问题出发，检索原文、检查证据、组织概念、建立研究项目，并将研究继续带入 Obsidian。

zh: 未配置 obsidian:// URI。请直接打开这个 vault 文件夹：

zh: 在 Research 输入一个问题

zh: 阅读回答

zh: 打开 Evidence

zh: 点击某一 passage 查看原文

zh: 在 Obsidian 中继续做自己的笔记

zh: 查看完整教程

zh: 第一次使用？5 分钟完成第一次研究

zh: 你想做什么？

zh: Project 是什么？

en: A Project keeps repeated Research runs, passages, persons, cases and bibliography together as one long-term topic. Project content is not corpus evidence.
zh: Project 用于把多次 Research、Passage、人物、个案和书目组织成长期课题。Project 里的内容不是 corpus evidence。

zh: 创建第一个 Project

zh: 了解 Projects

zh: 研究问题

en: Browsing is not research, and a zero result here is not an abstention — the corpus simply has no indexed match for this query. Try another term, or read how Explore works.
zh: 浏览不是研究，这里的零结果也不是弃权 —— 只是语料里没有与这个查询匹配的已索引内容。换一个词试试，或先了解 Explore 怎么用。

en: How Explore works
zh: Explore 怎么用

en: No passage matches that query
zh: 没有匹配的段落

en: Ask it as a research question instead
zh: 改成研究问题来问
